output.summary: The decline is mostly a migration artifact, not the executive director. 702 of 1,140 sustainer profiles were imported without payment methods and GiveLedger never charges them. That matches the $301k sustainer drop, and the ED arrived after cutover. Major gifts fell because of Brandt's one-off $75k; non-Brandt major giving rose. The CardVault deposits ($25-26k/month) roughly equal the corporate pledges plus kitchen fees (~$25.5k/month), so they probably are not hidden individual gifts. That is unconfirmed. Mill-closure and appeal-tone effects are plausible but unestablished. Do not terminate the ED. Reconcile CardVault now, keep the account open, assign donor calls, and check sampled sustainers before mass outreach.
